android_mechanism: Suggestions materialize all matching history rows instead of a bounded recent subset
bug_description: WebPage.onTitleReceive serializes the ENTIRE browsing-history list with JSON.stringify(list.map(...)) twice (before and after every recorded page visit), and HistoryPage.aboutToAppear stringifies the whole list again when the history page opens. With a large history this materializes and stringifies hundreds of entries on every page-load title event, blocking the web page load path and the history page transition.
fix_summary: The debug logs report the list size only, removing full-list map + JSON.stringify on the page-load and page-open paths.

test_oracle.definition: on-CPU time of the app process during the measured step, from the sched events in trace.htrace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: phase-scoped cpu 49.9 vs 0.1 ms; whole-window instructions do not discriminate (page-open work dominates), so the oracle is the title-event phase CPU

mechanism_oracle.definition: CPU time of the app process across the case window, from trace.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed spends O(history_size) in JSON serialization per open (grows with history); fixed is O(1). With 100+ entries unfixed > fixed by >= 30% on the title-event path.

reproduction: git -C hosts/wanharmony checkout case/wanharmony_history_log_materialization/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/wanharmony checkout case/wanharmony_history_log_materialization/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
